title: bn254-pairing-inversion: Pure-Scalar C6-m184_w216-rec STNFS with Exact-Int Q1.60 Band-3 (p_num=0), 3-Class 2-Adic Yield, Root-Only I.I.D. B_max=10 NB(r=1) Metered-DAG Descent (t=2^112), Strict <2^64B Buffers, 3-Prime NTT, W_SB=256 SWAR, & Unplanted 5-SM Z[omega] LA: 2^87.472484309

claims.statement: For the full-production bn254-pairing-inversion target, the self-contained 100% pure-scalar AArch64 algorithm of proof.md (C6-m184_w216-rec content-reduced reciprocal rank-2 totally imaginary sextic tower, order-6 Frobenius tau = Frob^10, exact rational sigma(w) == w twist invariance, exact 3-class disjoint 2-adic yield and cofactor summation (7/9:(0,0), 1/9:(0,3), 1/9:(6,0)) with odd-part alphas and class-matched Euler-product Retention, score-only 3-band g-side sieving at B_f = 2^61, B_g = 2^60, excess 0.82 with strict < 2^64 B per-owner buffered hit transfers as primary: Band-1 [2^14, 2^43) explicit 7-op 64-bit x_a linear-index producer emit (x_h = x_row_base + x_a, zero 32-bit truncation) + 2-op copy + 4.25-op apply (C_HIT_LO = 13.25 Ir/hit) + early4_find, Band-2 [2^43, 2^55) 8-lane 64-bit SWAR sb_u7 per-SB tight q_min_j gate at W_SB = 256 guaranteeing max_sb = 5 <= 8 on every row + 8B per-owner buffer (C_HIT_HI = 14.5 Ir/hit), Band-3 [2^55, 2^59) sigma-orbit-folded 12D Optimal Bounding Ellipsoid E* = {0.5*u + v/(2*(1-kap)) <= 1} Fincke-Pohst walk on 1/3 as many ideals with exact provable volume ratio VR_12 = 2.238988x over active R = {u <= 1, v + kap*u <= 1}, unconditional chunk-init bound N_chunks <= fp12_nodes_int + N_leaves/512 charging C_FP12_CHUNK_INIT = 120.0 Ir on every internal node + 120/512 per leaf, exact 128-bit integer Q1.60 Gram-matrix initialization with zero accumulated recurrence drift and 3-line Cauchy-Schwarz error bound < 2^-35 < EPS_Q60 = 2^-34 plus +2^-30 internal-node radius padding giving p_num = 0 unconditionally (zero 2^-48 numerical failure term!), 20 Ir worst-case pure-integer -mgeneral-regs-only leaf gate on all E* leaves + Voronoi unit-FD, uint16_t 64-bit SWAR scan+zero, 100% score-only Stage B stripping the exact 2^14-smooth part m via 417 64-bit prime-product chunks + disjoint large-prime windows with ZERO sieve prime recording and genuine all-89,151-active-cell norm histogram for cof_b divided by n_in once, closed-form 3-prime 64-bit radix-2 Cooley-Tukey NTT + Karatsuba with ZERO H-FFT heuristic, live full de Bruijn rho_dB, un-discounted 5-column random-compressed Schirokauer maps W_f(P_chi Lambda_f) and W_g(P_chi Lambda_g), 1-owner 3-bucket Z[omega] Block Wiedemann (bw = (768, 30), 2^59.61 B) with deterministic pre-merge guard W_avg <= 161.0, zero-column-loss excess-row trim + reverse re-purge back-substitution, and 4-parameter hard caps (N_sw_cap = 0.00160*U', N_l_cap = 0.00098*U', k5_cap = 12.00, tab_r_cap = 0.85, lazy = 0) under fixed-instance premise H3, and live 62-row LB=59 zero-retry-DAG (k = 1, boot_rels = 1) + B_max = 10 strictly i.i.d. fresh-e_t root-only boot retries per log with strictly decreasing norm DAG, per-run ideal-log cache giving P(repeat) = 0 (cleared between root runs for exact i.i.d. independence), unconditional missing-FB-leaf rejection, ultra-weak geometric NB(r = 1.0, alpha = 1.0) reached-ideal ensemble H5 (p0_max = 1.406e-3, single-run Boole union Phi_1 = 0.2457 <= 0.35 -> 2 * Phi_1^10 = 1.605e-6 across both logs, E[runs] <= 1.3258x), single-owner < 2^64 B boot tree built once (x_EA = 64.42, root 2^62.95 B), expected DAG/boot work under H-EA, and hard aborting combined-log meter t = 2^112 units with Markov tail E[D]/t = 6.411e-9 < 1e-8 in FIX-U) returns Q = [x] Q0 in G2 with e(P0, Q) = z (charging explicit G2 scalar multiplication output <= 2^11.761903 units) with success at least 0.39 over uniform challenges and fresh coins, and expected total classical work E[W] <= 1 + (K/2^64) * 2^88.830928181 <= 2^87.472484309 units (C = 20,000 scalar AArch64 instruction equivalents; strictly an expected-work bound, not an every-run bound), under declared exploratory model inequalities H1-H5, H-EA, H-SM, H-R, H-X, and H-SEP (proof.md Section 6 and RANK-BRIDGE.md; zero H-FFT heuristic). A run gate opens the run iff a fresh 64-bit coin is below K = 7194280548710566105, the least integer with (K/2^64) * 0.999993 >= 0.39; a closed run fails at cost 1 unit. Opened-run success >= 0.999993 is bounded by a strict additive union bound (FIX-U, p_num = 0). Finite-scale prototypes provide compatibility evidence (supported, not proved); neither simulator outcomes nor sample confidence intervals are substituted for the attack's production success probability. All preprocessing, failed trials, aborts, verification, and output are charged once for this target; nothing is amortized.

experiments.purpose: Self-contained pure-stdlib live verification (19/19 checks) of: BN254 + C6-m184_w216-rec algebra, exact rational sigma(w) == w, 3 explicit 64-bit radix-2 NTT primes, boot identity, and mod-r CRT across all 6 roots; exhaustive R^2=50 Voronoi FD bijection (107/107, 0 missed, 0 dups); 8-lane SWAR sb_u7 Band-2 prototype (1523/1523, 0 mismatches, max_sb <= 8), 64-bit a_slot linear arena index test, P_2 +48 threshold check, 10k uint16 SWAR scan+zero, and 417-chunk score-only P_14 Stage-B strip + disjoint windows (0 errors); live sigma-orbit-folded 12D Optimal Bounding Ellipsoid E* Fincke-Pohst Band-3 prototype across 4 real C6 orbits executing exact 128-bit integer Q1.60 Gram initialization with zero recurrence drift + live production-magnitude (Ra=468.87, Rb=1547.36) 512-step Cauchy-Schwarz error check (408/408, 0 missed, 0 dups, 0 drift, 0 Q1.60 false negatives, p_num=0); paired 12D lattice diagnostic on 24 special-q bases (12f+12g, 2^66..2^213) and 8 genuine G_T boot witnesses over FULL B_12(4) (13,315,520 cells; 6/6 sextiles + 5/5 quintiles); 224-ideal real C6 tau-invariant (6,2) usable-relation (simulated missing-FB-leaf discard + p_ecm=0.996 per-factor ECM thinning) & depth-2 (100 d1 + 24 d2 + 100 ctrl) NB(r=1) & NB(r=2) PGF + two-sided H-EA survivor campaign with live 16-ball replay (4 full 2-hop chains q_0->q_1->q_2 + 4 1-hop + 4 ctrl, 0/224 empty, S_obs/sv_up < 1.0); exact 3-class 2-adic yield & all-89,151-active-cell cof_b; live pure-Python Z[omega] filtering simulator at U'=2^13 (kernel_errors=0, zero-column-loss excess trim + reverse repurge back-sub) and U'=2^14 + 5-scale ALL4 ladder; live UNPLANTED 2-sided 5-SM NFS Block-Wiedemann + F_1187^* DLP recovery (275^468 == 679 mod 1187) + Z[omega] Schur check (hx_z6.py); full de Bruijn 17-row ledger, fixed-instance H3 4-cap 1-owner LA (bw=[768,30]), live 62-row LB=59 k=1 DAG + B_max=10 root-only i.i.d. NB(r=1) descent with t=2^112 Markov meter, FIX-U (p_num=0), and exact rational gate K.
